name: Cyclizine
metabolism: Absorbed well from the gut. Taken by mouth it starts working within 30 minutes, is at its strongest after 1-2 hours, and lasts 4-6 hours. A single 50 mg oral dose in healthy adult volunteers gave a peak blood level of about 70 ng/mL at around two hours, and it stayed in the body for about 20 hours. The main breakdown product is norcyclizine, the version with the methyl group taken off; it does much less to block histamine than cyclizine does, it also stays about 20 hours, and it spreads widely through the tissues. In one adult man who took a single 50 mg dose, less than 1% of it came out in his urine over the following 24 hours.
summary: Cyclizine is an antihistamine and anticholinergic medication used to treat and prevent nausea, vomiting, and dizziness, including motion sickness and vertigo.
